name: player-attack-pig
comment: WP-2.5a. The attack op with the player as the attacker (Minecraft.clickMouse(0), ENTITY branch: swingItem, PlayerController.attackEntity = EntityPlayer.attackTargetEntityWithCurrentItem). The player (id 0) holds a wooden sword (slot 0); a pig (id 1) stands 3 blocks ahead on the stone floor. Damage: ItemSword.getDamageVsEntity 4 (+1 because motionY < 0: standing on the ground still has the gravity step), the pig's EntityLiving.attackEntityFrom knocks it back from the player; ItemSword.hitEntity wears the sword by 1. t 10 and t 15 (inside the pig's hurt window: only damage above the window's first hit counts), t 30 kills it (EntityLiving.onDeath: addToPlayerScore with scoreValue 0, the pig's drops); the porkchops land beyond the player's pick-up reach. t 50: a punch at a corpse (health <= 0: no effect).
